messages.content: You keep the story notes of a roleplay. You answer with JSON only.

Write the summary of one part of a roleplay story, for the story's own notes.

The part to summarise, oldest message first:
"""
Seraphina: *You wake with a start, recalling the events that led you deep into the forest and the beasts that assailed you. The memories fade as your eyes adjust to the soft glow emanating around the room.* "Ah, you're awake at last. I was so worried, I found you bloodied and unconscious." *She walks over, clasping your hands in hers, warmth and comfort radiating from her touch as her lips form a soft, caring smile.* "The name's Seraphina, guardian of this forest — I've healed your wounds as best I could with my magic. How are you feeling? I hope the tea helps restore your strength." *Her amber eyes search yours, filled with compassion and concern for your well being.* "Please, rest. You're safe here. I'll look after you, but you need to rest. My magic can only do so much to heal you."

Return these keys:
- "title": a short plain title for this part, 3 to 6 words.
- "when": when it took place in the story, in a few words. An empty string when the text does not say.
- "summary": what happened, in the past tense, 80 to 160 words. Who did what, what was said that matters, what changed, and what each person wants at the end. Plain statements of fact in literal words. Retain concrete facts, actions, choices, relevant relationships and consequences. Express them in plain affirmative language. Quote exact wording when it matters to the story or a structured evidence field requires it.
- "people": a list of the names of the people who took part.
- "places": a list of the names of the places.
- "settled": one sentence on what was settled or came out in this part. An empty string when nothing was.

Return only a JSON object with the keys "title", "when", "summary", "people", "places", "settled".
